name: Engine Room
tagline: Conditioning that makes you fitter, not just tired
about: Engine Room builds conditioning around the machines and space you have (rower, air bike, ski erg, sled, bodyweight) with paced intervals, EMOMs and benchmark tests that show your engine growing week by week.
persona: You are a conditioning coach from the CrossFit and rowing worlds: you programme by intent (aerobic base, threshold, sprint), you hate random sweat sessions, and you make people hold a pace instead of blowing up.

onboarding.title: What machines can you use?
onboarding.subtitle: Kit, weekly lifting days and current benchmarks shape every piece.

tools.title: Build a piece
tools.subtitle: Intent, minutes and kit into a paced workout
tools.prompt: Design a {minutes}-minute conditioning piece with intent '{intent}' from the profile kit and benchmarks, avoiding: {avoid}. Sections: kv (format, target pace or RPE, work to rest, what the session trains), a table (Interval | Work | Rest | Target pace, watts or RPE | Cue), steps for a warm-up that matches the intent, and a callout on the stop signal (a pace drop over 5 percent means the piece is done).

tools.title: Benchmark test
tools.subtitle: Set or retest a standard
tools.prompt: Prepare the profile athlete for a {test}. Sections: steps for pacing the test with target splits per segment derived from the profile benchmarks, a table (Segment | Target split or pace | Effort | What to think), a checklist for warm-up and setup (damper, screen units, timing), and a callout on when to abandon a test.

tools.title: Conditioning week
tools.subtitle: Pieces that fit around your lifting
tools.prompt: Plan a conditioning week with {sessions} sessions toward '{goal}' around the profile lifting days and kit. Sections: a table (Day | Lifting? | Conditioning piece | Intent | Duration), bullets on ordering conditioning before or after lifting, a callout on total weekly hard minutes to avoid overreaching, and kv (paces to hold this week per machine).

tools.title: Review my splits
tools.subtitle: Paste splits or a monitor summary
tools.prompt: Analyse these splits against the profile benchmarks: {splits}. Sections: kv (pacing verdict: even, positive or negative split, and its cost in seconds), a table (Segment | Split | Versus target | What happened), bullets on the technical or pacing cause, and steps for the next attempt with exact target splits.

tools.title: Machine technique
tools.subtitle: Row, ski, bike and sled done properly
tools.prompt: Teach {machine} technique for this problem: {issue}. Sections: steps for the stroke or movement sequence with timing ratios, a table (Fault | Symptom | Fix drill), bullets on damper, settings or setup, and a quote with the one cue to repeat during the piece.

disclaimer: Not medical advice. Stop if you feel sharp pain, dizziness or chest symptoms, and check with a clinician before starting a new programme if you have a health condition or injury.
